commits.message: feat(onchain,sdk,fault-proofs): build the Q40 fabricated-withdrawal family complete to the blueprint boundary (#482)
docs(evidence,scripts): land the Q39 per-family closure surfaces and close output 10 in the same pass (#482)
feat(fault-proofs): add the Q39 fabricated-deposit prepare/submit surfaces and family suite to the blueprint boundary (#482)

feat(fault-proofs): source the observe door from a published item-observe reference script (#617 item 1, #597 ruling a)

Add the validationTraceDisputeItemObserve deployment-info role, mirroring
validationTraceDisputeItemSemantic exactly: a plain reference-script
publication with no auth token and no manifest-identity surface, so the
deployment manifestId does not move. submitValidationDisputeSemanticResolution
resolves the entry up front beside the item-semantic one and the observe
stage - the SS8.8 door, the stage whose envelope the carriage bytes need -
sources canonical_decode_item_observe_v1 by reference instead of embedding
the 9,108-byte applied body.

Measured precondition (#617 first step): the applied observe body publishes
as a real signed 9,384-byte transaction, 7,000 bytes under the 16,384-byte
envelope.

Emulator suites publish the observe reference script beside the item-semantic
one and pin the observation transaction script-free with the applied body
absent from its CBOR; the stage reference-input pattern moves to
[1, 0, 1, 0, 0] on the direct route and [0, 2, 0, 2, 0, 0] on the reference
route. buildRemovalDeploymentInfo gains the observe slot ahead of
removalReferenceScripts, with every positional call site widened.
feat(onchain,sdk): build the Q39 fabricated-deposit family selectors and byte twins (#482)
docs(evidence,fault-proofs): land the Q14 output-10 parent integration and register the queue row (#481)
docs(evidence,scripts): build the Q14 per-family closure surfaces and supersede the stale manifest census (#481)

docs(evidence,fault-proofs): close the Q49 structural partials and re-derive the reconciliation audit to 9 PASS (#481)

Execute the Q49 handoff artifact's remaining pendingEdits: the
reconciliation structuralAudit moves L298 (cross-block replay) and
L302 (malformed validity interval) from PARTIAL to PASS with
remainingTask cleared, empties taskResidues.openStructural, and
recounts the summary to 9 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 0 OPEN - the executable
evidence was already recorded on both rows and is measured green by
the Q49 gate's 31 runner-executed checks under the pinned fork
compiler.

Re-pin the reconciliation verifier's deliberate exact pins in the
same edit set (summary deep-equal, disposition filters, the
structuralContract row pins, the PASS-row allowlist, and the
first-queue F21 regex, which now requires both the retained 7/2
provenance and the closure supersede), supersede the ledger F21 queue
row in place, and fix coverage-matrix L298's evidence cell to cite
the two #582 witness-faithful step-03 selectors, clearing the
pre-#582 name drift deferred by the Q10/Q11/Q12 passes.

Measured after the edits: Q49 gate PASS exit 0; quality gate PASS
186/186 with 0 defects; the reconciliation verifier executes every
re-pinned assert green and exits 1 solely on the accepted Q02
permissive-dispatch scanner baseline, the same red it carries at
HEAD.

docs(evidence,fault-proofs): land the Q12 output-10 parent integration and register the queue row (#481)

Execute the Q12 artifact's parentIntegration.pendingEdits: the two
matrix Status cells (coverage-matrix L137, catalogue-status L21) now
record the pinned Q13-form local closure, the artifact re-derives
output 10 LOCAL_PASS from the re-measured cells (10 LOCAL_PASS / 0
OPEN, the original derivation retained under whyPreviouslyOpen), and
the gate re-measures PASS exit 0 under the pinned fork compiler.

Add the Q12 PASS queue row to GOAL_PROGRESS (outputs 1-10 LOCAL_PASS
with measured counts; the output-9 gaps stay owned as Q12-F4/F5;
LIVE_PASS explicitly not claimed), and pre-empt the
staleBlockedOnPass defects: Q50/Q51/Q55/QG1 blockedOn arrays no
longer name Q12, with the four rows' prose re-scoped to Q14 as the
remaining non-PASS first-queue family. Quality gate: PASS 186/186, 0
defects, first-queue IDs 121 -> 122.

docs(evidence,scripts): build the Q12 per-family closure surfaces and supersede the stale manifest census (#481)

Add canonical-v1-proof-family-q12-v1.json gated by
verify-canonical-v1-proof-family-q12.mjs: 9 LOCAL_PASS / 1 OPEN / 0
N/A under the pinned fork compiler. Outputs 1-4 and 9 measured
family-locally (10/10 selectors across the two step modules with a
step-scoped-positive floor per module so the three normalizer unit
helpers cannot stand in for deleted proof-step positives; 72 vitest
tests over 4 suites; 4 shared-suite emulator lifecycles, 1 this
family's), output 3 LOCAL_PASS as a measured committed-field absence
bound to the spec tables, outputs 5-8 delegated to the shared Q1x
artifact with the spend-input cardinality axis gated bidirectionally
out of scope, output 10 OPEN on the parent-owned matrix rows with the
pending edits pinned. 10 negative self-tests and 3 positive controls
run in-gate.

Supersede the manifest Q12 row in place: the exactly-7 / 8-of-8
census pins were mutually inconsistent and both wrong (10 measured),
the step-02-has-ZERO-tests anchor is measured false (2 selectors),
and the step_01 focused command cited
invalid_range_step_01_rejects_a_missing_verifier_invocation, which
exists only in no-input/step-03 - the command ran one test short
while exiting 0; re-pinned onto the three existing chunk selectors.
Quality gate: PASS 186/186, 0 defects.

docs(evidence,fault-proofs): land the Q10/Q11 output-10 parent integration and reconcile the stale blocked-on rows (#481)

Execute both family artifacts' parentIntegration.pendingEdits: the four
matrix Status cells (coverage-matrix L96/L94, catalogue-status L19/L20)
now record the pinned LOCAL_PASS form, both artifacts re-derive output
10 LOCAL_PASS from the re-measured cells (10 LOCAL_PASS / 0 OPEN, the
original derivation retained under whyPreviouslyOpen, F1 gap superseded
to observation), and both gates re-measure PASS exit 0 under the pinned
fork compiler with the output-10 print suffix now derived instead of
hardcoded.

Re-pin the manifest Q10 row's focusedCommand that cited
double_spend_step_01_rejects_a_missing_verifier_invocation - measured
absent from the entire double-spend family (never existed in any
committed tree); the re-pinned three-selector command measures exit 0.

Add the Q10/Q11 PASS queue rows to GOAL_PROGRESS (LIVE_PASS explicitly
not claimed; live evidence remains Q57/QG3), and reconcile the eight
staleBlockedOnPass defects that surfaced: Q50/Q51/Q55/QG1 blockedOn
arrays no longer name the pair, with prose re-scoped. Manifest quality
gate: PASS 186/186, 0 defects, first-queue IDs 119 -> 121.

executedChecks 30->31, and the reconciliation row's prose citation.

Measured: Q49 structural handoff PASS (9 rows, 31 runner-executed
checks, 0 partial, 0 open); fp-reconciliation reds solely on the
accepted Q02 scanner baseline, unchanged.
